name: Québec — CMHC purpose-built apartment vacancy rate, October 2025
description: Share of privately initiated purpose-built rental apartment units in Québec CMA that were vacant and available for immediate rental in October 2025 (CMHC Rental Market Survey).

attributes.notes: Private apartment vacancy rate, all bedroom types: October 2024 0.9%, October 2025 2.4% (quality 'a'). Two-bedroom only: 1.0% → 2.5% (quality 'a'). year_over_year_change_pct left null because the change is in percentage points.

sources.title: Rental Market Survey Data Tables, Québec CMA, 2025 (Table 1.1.1)
sources.methodology: CMHC Rental Market Survey, October 2025: privately initiated purpose-built rental apartment structures of three or more units; survey of landlords/property managers; quality grades a–d, ** = suppressed.

sources.title: Table 34-10-0130-01, CMHC vacancy rates, row and apartment structures of three units and over, CMAs — Québec, Quebec (vector v1930316)
sources.methodology: Row-and-apartment vacancy rate (broader than the apartment-only figure stored here); 2025 value 2.4%.
sources.licence: Statistics Canada Open Licence (https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/reference/licence); attribution 'Source: Statistics Canada' required.

verification.notes: Value read from the CMHC Excel data table downloaded on 2026-10-30.

limitations: Vacancy measures units vacant and ready to rent on the survey date; it excludes condominium rentals and secondary market units. A low rate signals a tight market but says nothing about asking rents.
